title: 36 Hours in Burlington, Vt.
abstract: Outdoor saunas (with a cold lake plunge), breweries and fall hikes await in Vermont’s largest city and its nearby towns.

title: 36 Hours in Charleston, S.C.
abstract: A major new African American history museum unlocks new perspectives of one of America’s oldest cities.

title: 36 Hours in Santiago, Chile
abstract: Against the arresting backdrop of the Andes, the Chilean capital is alive with music, art and nightlife.

title: 36 Hours in Chicago
abstract: Cycle miles of urban trails, tour a restored Frank Lloyd Wright masterwork and catch golden hour along Lake Michigan.
